title: 36 Hours in Vancouver, British Columbia
abstract: It’s never been easier to explore this coastal city, where once-quiet neighborhoods now buzz with new global restaurants and community art spaces.

title: 36 Hours in the Finger Lakes, N.Y.
abstract: Enjoy peak foliage season in this upstate New York region, which offers waterfall hikes, farm-to-table restaurants and a famous wine trail.

title: 36 Hours in Tunis
abstract: Tunisia’s capital is replete with wonders both ancient and modern, from archaeological ruins to a kinetic contemporary art scene.

title: 36 Hours in Kansas City, Mo.
abstract: Bounce between the Missouri city and its same-named Kansas neighbor for lip-smacking barbecue, live jazz, a taco trail and a spirited sports scene.

title: 36 Hours in Buenos Aires
abstract: At once nostalgic and ever-changing, the Argentine capital remains unreservedly itself.
